Generic OPTION CLAUSE: The Purchaser reserves the right to increase or decrease the quantity to be ordered up to 25 percent of bid quantity at the time of placement of contract. The purchaser also reserves the right to increase the ordered quantity up to 25% of the contracted quantity during the currency of the contract at the contracted rates. The delivery period of quantity shall commence from the last date of original delivery order and in cases where option clause is exercised during the extended delivery period the additional time shall commence from the last date of extended delivery period. The additional delivery time shall be (Increased quantity ÷ Original quantity) × Original delivery period (in days), subject to minimum of 30 days. If the original delivery period is less than 30 days, the additional time equals the original delivery period. The Purchaser may extend this calculated delivery duration up to the original delivery period while exercising the option clause. Bidders must comply with these terms. 2. Generic Bidder financial standing: The bidder should not be under liquidation, court receivership or similar proceedings, should not be bankrupt. Bidder to upload undertaking to this effect with bid. 3. Generic Data Sheet of the product(s) offered in the bid, are to be uploaded along with the bid documents. Buyers can match and verify the Data Sheet with the product specifications offered. In case of any unexplained mismatch of technical parameters, the bid is liable for rejection. 4. Generic Experience Criteria: The Bidder or its OEM {themselves or through reseller(s)} should have regularly, manufactured and supplied same or similar Category Products to any Central / State Govt Organization / PSU for 3 years before the bid opening date. Copies of relevant contracts to be submitted along with bid in support of having supplied some quantity during each of the year. In case of bunch bids, the primary product having highest value should meet this criterion. 5. Generic

Installation, Commissioning, Testing, Configuration, Training (if any - which ever is applicable as per scope of supply) is to be carried out by OEM / OEM Certified resource or OEM authorised Reseller. 6. Generic Manufacturer Authorization:Wherever Authorised Distributors/service providers are submitting the bid, Authorisation Form /Certificate with OEM/Original Service Provider details such as name, designation, address, e-mail Id and Phone No. required to be furnished along with the bid 7. Generic Scope of supply includes Training: Number of employees to be trained 2 , Place for Training IIT Jodhpur and Duration of training 2 days. 8. Generic 1. The Seller shall not assign the Contract in whole or part without obtaining the prior written consent of buyer. 2. The Seller shall not sub-contract the Contract in whole or part to any entity without obtaining the prior written consent of buyer. 3. The Seller shall, notwithstanding the consent and assignment/sub-contract, remain jointly and severally liable and responsible to buyer together with the assignee/ sub-contractor, for and in respect of the due performance of the Contract and the Sellers obligations there under. 9. Scope of Supply Scope of supply (Bid price to include all cost components) : Supply Installation Testing Commissioning of Goods and Training of operators and providing Statutory Clearances required (if any) 10. OEM IMPORTED PRODUCTS: In case of imported products, OEM or Authorized Seller of OEM should have a registered office in India to provide after sales service support in India. The certificate to this effect should be submitted. 11. Service & Support Dedicated /toll Free Telephone No. for Service Support : BIDDER/OEM must have Dedicated/toll Free Telephone No. for Service Support. 12. Service & Support Escalation Matrix For Service Support : Bidder/OEM must provide Escalation Matrix of Telephone Numbers for Service Support. 13. Certificates Bidder's offer is liable to be rejected if they don't upload any of the certificates / documents sought in the Bid document, ATC and Corrigendum if any. 14. Warranty Warranty period of the supplied products shall be 1 years from the date of final acceptance of goods or after completion of installation, commissioning & testing of goods (if included in the scope of supply), at consignee location. OEM Warranty certificates must be submitted by Successful Bidder at the time of delivery of Goods. The seller should guarantee the rectification of goods in case of any break down during the guarantee period. Seller should have well established Installation, Commissioning, Training,

Troubleshooting and Maintenance Service group in INDIA for attending the after sales service. Details of Service Centres near consignee destinations are to be uploaded along with the bid. 15. Warranty Successful bidder will have to ensure that adequate number of dedicated technical service personals / engineers are designated / deployed for attending to the Service Request in a time bound manner and for ensuring Timely Servicing / rectification of defects during warranty period, as per Service level agreement indicated in the relevant clause of the bid. 16. Warranty Timely Servicing / rectification of defects during warranty period: After having been notified of the defects / service requirement during warranty period, Seller has to complete the required Service / Rectification within 7 days time limit. If the Seller fails to complete service / rectification with defined time limit, a penalty of 0.5% of Unit Price of the product shall be charged as penalty for each week of delay from the seller. Seller can deposit the penalty with the Buyer directly else the Buyer shall have a right to recover all such penalty amount from the Performance Security (PBG).Cumulative Penalty cannot exceed more than 10% of the total contract value after which the Buyer shall have the right to get the service / rectification done from alternate sources at the risk and cost of the Seller besides forfeiture of PBG. Seller shall be liable to re-imberse the cost of such service / rectification to the Buyer. 17. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer uploaded ATC document Click here to view the file. 18. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses Mandatory Terms and Conditions for Quotation of Prices for the ‘Micro-PL System and Its Accessories (to be coupled to the TRPL System)’ 1. Scope of supply and complete system cost a. The bidder shall quote a single consolidated price for the complete Micro-PL system, including all manda tory components, accessories, software, hardware, interfacing requirements, and other items necessary fo r the successful installation, integration, commissioning, and operation of the system as specified in the te nder. Compatibility of the proposed system and its software with the existing TRPL system is mandatory. T he vendor shall ensure seamless compatibility and proper functioning of the integrated system. b. The bidder shall provide an item-wise price breakup of all components included in the main system. Ho wever, the consolidated price of the complete system shall be clearly indicated as the Total Quoted Price f or the Complete System. All mandatory components and accessories specified in the tender shall be includ ed in this price and in INR only. No mandatory component or accessory shall be treated as an optional ite m or charged separately over and above the quoted total price. 2. Optional items a. Optional items, if any, shall be quoted separately in a clearly identified section of the financial bid. The p rice of each optional item shall be indicated individually in INR, including applicable GST and all other asso ciated charges. The prices of optional items shall not be included in the consolidated price of the main system or in the tot al evaluated price of the main system. Quoting an optional item shall not create any obligation on the Insti tute to purchase it. 3. Price inclusiveness and no additional charges a. The consolidated price quoted for the complete system shall be inclusive of all applicable taxes, includin g GST, customs duties and other statutory levies wherever applicable and contractually payable by the Ins titute, as well as packing, forwarding, freight, transportation, transit insurance, loading, unloading, delivery , installation, interfacing, integration, testing, commissioning, demonstration, and user training, wherever s pecified in the tender. b. The bidder shall clearly indicate the applicable tax rates and amounts in the financial bid.

c. Any applicable statutory change in taxes or duties shall be dealt with strictly in accordance with the ten der conditions and applicable rules. 4. Delivery at CRF, IIT Jodhpur a. The complete system, including all mandatory components and accessories, shall be delivered on a Deli vered Duty Paid (DDP) basis to the Central Research Facility (CRF), IIT Jodhpur, Rajasthan, at the bidder's q uoted consolidated price. b. The bidder shall be responsible for safe packing, transportation, transit insurance, delivery at the design ated installation site, and all associated logistics costs. The bidder shall also be responsible for installation, integration, testing, commissioning, and demonstration of satisfactory functioning of the complete system, as specified in the tender. 5. Currency of quotation and payment All prices shall be quoted in Indian Rupees (INR) only, and payments under the resulting contract shall be made in INR only, in accordance with the applicable procurement rules and contract conditions. The bidder shall clearly indicate the basic price, applicable taxes, and the final consolidated price in the prescribed fin ancial bid format. 6. Payment after successful installation and commissioning No payment shall be released before the successful installation and satisfactory functioning of the equipm ent. 100% of the payment shall be released only after the complete system, including all mandatory comp onents and accessories, has been delivered, installed, integrated with the existing TRPL system, tested, an d commissioned, and its satisfactory functioning has been demonstrated and formally accepted by the aut horized officials of IIT Jodhpur, in accordance with the tender specifications and terms and conditions. 7. Contractual responsibility for system integration a. The successful bidder shall be responsible for ensuring that the supplied Micro-PL system and all manda tory components are compatible with and properly integrated with the existing TRPL system, as required u nder the tender. The bidder shall resolve hardware- and software-related integration issues attributable to the supplied system or its integration, without additional cost to the Institute. b. Liquid Nitrogen in sufficient quantity must be arranged by the bidder required for the successful installa tion and demonstration of the low-temperature stage. c. The system shall be considered successfully commissioned only after the specified integration, functiona l testing, and acceptance requirements have been fulfilled. 8. Technical Documents and Equipment Details: The vendor shall submit relevant photographs, product ca talogues, and technical brochures for the equipment and all associated accessories along with the technica l bid. The technical offer shall also clearly specify the equipment's dimensions, weight, and space requirem ents for installation. 9. Maintenance Support: The vendor shall provide maintenance support for a minimum period of one year. The vendor shall explicitly confirm its commitment to providing the required maintenance and technical su pport during this period. Suggested financial bid format Use a prescribed table so that bidders cannot combine the main system and optional items ambiguously. Sl. No. Description Price in INR 1 Complete Micro-PL system, including all mandatory components and accessories ₹_____ 2 Applicable GST on the main system, if not already included above ₹_____ 3 Delivery (DDP Only), transportation, insurance, installation, integration, commissioning, training, and o ther included charges, if separately itemized ₹_____ 4 Total consolidated price of the complete mandatory system ₹_____ 5 Optional Item 1 — quoted separately ₹_____ 6 Optional Item 2 — quoted separately ₹_____ The financial bid should clarify whether each line is included in the consolidated total, to prevent double co unting. The final total should include every mandatory cost, with optional items excluded from the main sy stem total.
